name: 01940 · Lynnfield, MA
findings: ZIP 01940 (Lynnfield) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01940 (Lynnfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01940 (Lynnfield) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).
